chapter: Trombone technique, plunger mute and the California years
title: Tricky Sam Nanton, the first plunger trombonist
summary: He met the trombonist who started plunger playing out West and learns he died in 1947.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: There's been quite a few trumpet players used plungers, but the one on the trombone -- that first started the trombone thing -- playing with the plunger was Joe Manton (PHONETIC) you know. Georgia Sam.
You heard him on records and stuff.

Yeah, I met him years ago and -- in the early '30s I met him and -- it could have been in the '20s. Anyway, I met him out West. Just -- he didn't live too very much longer after this -- I guess he lived seven-eight more years I think.
No. He just fell out of the road I guess.
